post.description: Answer from stored passages only. Status `provider_error` keeps the resolved sources.

get.description: Always HTTP 200; `status` says whether traversal is available.
Manifest, flat per-question rows (the CSV columns), and answers prepared for review.

200.description: Columns: question_id, split, repetition, method, answerable, filtered, recall_at_5, articles_found, exhausted, cutoff_reached, top_article_ids, embedding_ms, retrieval_ms, answer_status, generation_ms, review_status

chunk_ids.title: Chunk Ids
chunk_ids.description: Chunk IDs from a search response, in rank order; the server reads the text

corpus_version.title: Corpus Version
corpus_version.description: corpus_version of the search response the chunk IDs came from

text.title: Text
text.description: Set only when status is answered; plain text

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: Labels cited by the answer, in first-use order

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description: Every non-2xx response except request-schema errors (FastAPI's 422 detail list).

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when node or edge caps cut the result

invalid.title: Invalid
invalid.description: Run directories that could not be read

RunManifest.title: RunManifest
RunManifest.description:
C08 manifest (schema citehop-eval-v1). Core fields are typed; the rest (config,
latency boundaries, hardware, warm-up, summary with denominators) is passed through as
saved, with nulls kept as null.

RunRow.title: RunRow
RunRow.description: One question repetition and method; the CSV export has exactly these columns.

linked_from.title: Linked From
linked_from.description: Only articles this article links to

embedding_config.title: Embedding Config
embedding_config.description: Vector config searched; null for keyword

embedding_ms.title: Embedding Ms
embedding_ms.description: Query embedding; null for keyword search
